stack_voltage_reported.meaning: conditional switches support; preserve reported name

pack_current.meaning: positive charging, negative discharging; conditional switches support

cell_temperatures.meaning: configured sensor positions; preserve unavailable entries

shunt_temperature.meaning: conditional sensor; unsupported in demo profile

soc.meaning: state of charge; not state of health

error_flags.meaning: unsigned uint32; null is not clear

cell_voltages.meaning: compact logical cells; channel mapping is explicit

cell_voltage_avg_reported.meaning: firmware aggregate; do not substitute our own

balancing_mask.meaning: hardware channels, not compact array positions

bms_state.meaning: OFF, CHG, DIS, NORMAL, SHUTDOWN, unknown, or null

faults.meaning: lexicographically sorted decoded codes, including unknown bits 15-31

cell_voltage_delta.meaning: max minus min of all configured valid cells; null when incomplete

cell_temperature_max.meaning: all configured battery sensors; null when incomplete

component_temperature_max.meaning: supported IC/MOSFET/shunt sensors; null when incomplete

soh.meaning: unsupported in pinned firmware; explicit null

cycle_count.meaning: unsupported in pinned firmware; explicit null
